name: A2A
description: A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol v1.0 support for Hermes Agent — both directions of the open Linux Foundation standard for inter-agent communication.

fields.name: A2A_PEER_TOKENS
fields.label: A2A per-peer tokens (name:token, comma-separated; or empty)
fields.description: Per-peer bearer tokens ('alice:tok1,bob:tok2'). Each remote agent gets its own credential; the matched name is the authenticated identity used for rate limiting, trust, and audit.

fields.name: A2A_BEARER_TOKEN
fields.label: A2A shared bearer token (or empty for localhost-only)
fields.description: Shared bearer token for inbound A2A calls (identity falls back to caller IP). With no token of any kind => bind to 127.0.0.1 only (no remote access).

fields.name: A2A_PUSH_SECRET
fields.label: A2A push signing secret (or empty)
fields.description: HMAC secret for signing push notifications (default: the shared bearer token).

fields.name: A2A_HOST
fields.label: A2A bind host (default 127.0.0.1)
fields.description: Inbound bind host. Defaults to 127.0.0.1; only widens to 0.0.0.0 when a bearer token is set AND you opt in here.

fields.name: A2A_PORT
fields.label: A2A port (default 9900)
fields.description: Inbound A2A server port (default 9900).

fields.name: A2A_AGENT_NAME
fields.label: A2A agent name
fields.description: Name advertised on this agent's Agent Card (default: hostname-derived).

fields.name: A2A_ALLOW_ALL_USERS
fields.label: Allow all A2A peers? (true/false)
fields.description: Allow any authenticated A2A peer to reach the agent (dev only).

fields.name: A2A_HOME_CHANNEL
fields.label: A2A home channel (or empty)
fields.description: Task/context id used as the cron / notification delivery target for deliver=a2a.
